long_biography.plain_text:
The purchase of Universal Dynamics gave Nicola Piovan’s machinery group a production base in the United States. He chose an established local manufacturer to bring the business closer to its American customers. The acquired company made drying, blending and material-handling equipment, adding to factories already operating in Italy, Brazil and China.

Through Fondazione Piovan, he supports projects for children facing poverty or barriers to education and healthcare. The foundation draws funding from the family holding company, Pentafin, and outside donors. The family’s support has included a school programme serving working children and adolescents on the outskirts of Lima.
